subject: Energy
title: The Promise of Fusion
description: Learn The Promise of Fusion in one minute.

hook.text: Fusion powers the Sun—merging hydrogen into helium and releasing enormous energy that could end energy scarcity.

buildup.text: Fusion fuel (deuterium) is abundant in seawater. A bathtub of water holds fusion energy equal to 300 barrels of oil.

discovery.text: Unlike fission, fusion produces no long-lived radioactive waste and cannot melt down—it's inherently safe.

twist.text: Scientists have chased fusion since the 1950s—the joke is it's always 30 years away, and has been for 70 years.

climax.text: But recent breakthroughs are real—in 2022 the NIF achieved ignition, producing more fusion energy than the laser input.

punchline.text: Bottling a star—fusion could be the ultimate energy source.

quiz.question: What fusion fuel is found abundantly in seawater?
